item.title: Lane closures planned next week for Furys Ferry Road widening project
item.description: Contractors with E. R. Snell will continue construction activities next week on the Furys Ferry Road widening project in Columbia County. The post Lane closures planned next week for Furys Ferry Road widening project appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Evans Towne Center Park to host pre-Valentine’s family celebration
item.description: Columbia County families are invited to celebrate Valentine’s Day early with a community event at Evans Towne Center Park on Friday, Feb. 13. The post Evans Towne Center Park to host pre-Valentine’s family celebration appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Weekend snow leads to Monday closures, e-learning across CSRA school districts
item.description: The snow is starting to go away but refreezing temperatures and icy roads are prompting schedule changes across several CSRA school districts Monday, Feb. 2, with systems citing hazardous travel conditions and continued safety concerns. The post Weekend snow leads to Monday closures, e-learning across CSRA school districts appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Commercial development proposed at intersection of Hardy McManus and Washington Road
item.description: A new retail center has been proposed in Evans, along the intersection of Washington and Hardy McManus Roads. The post Commercial development proposed at intersection of Hardy McManus and Washington Road appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: The Augusta Players and The Imperial Theatre to merge
item.description: The Augusta Players, the theatre company that has entertained the city for some 80 years, is merging with over-century-old Imperial Theatre. The post The Augusta Players and The Imperial Theatre to merge appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Columbia County Board of Commissioners to discuss data center rezoning requests Tuesday
item.description: Three data center rezoning requests will go before the Columbia County Board of Commissioners on Tuesday. The post Columbia County Board of Commissioners to discuss data center rezoning requests Tuesday appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Cold weather death in Augusta sparks grief and debate over homelessness
item.description: Authorities have identified the homeless man found dead Sunday near downtown Augusta during a winter storm and below-freezing temperatures, a death that has prompted grief, reflection and debate among Augusta residents. The post Cold weather death in Augusta sparks grief and debate over homelessness appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: USCA to host free International Film Festival throughout February
item.description: The University of South Carolina Aiken (USCA) will host its annual International Film Festival beginning Feb. 11 and running throughout February, offering free screenings of international films paired with faculty-led discussions open to students and the public. The post USCA to host free International Film Festival throughout February appeared first on The Augusta Press.
